what_differs: In the 09-23 transcript the column list 'operator, partner, market, country, state, vertical, and status' is Kobi's recap of the sign-up header discussion, not the table view. For the table view, Emily said she would work with Joyce and Lina on 'exactly how I want it laid out'. The actual table-view work is under WAGR-423 (Taryn) and uses Emily's spreadsheet with a different first-four set. WAGR-424 is still Open and unassigned, although the 09-30 meeting says Taryn is already working on the table view.
suggested_action: Remove the 'final column order' line from WAGR-424 (or mark it as the header recap) and point it to Emily's column template. Then merge WAGR-424 into WAGR-423, or assign WAGR-424 to Taryn and limit it to the freeze/inline-edit/CSV investigations, so that the table view has one ticket and one owner.
